title: 2.10 One and More than One
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Say Este/Esta es for one thing and Estos/Estas son for more than one, with the plural noun.
grammar_function: Este/Esta es un/una + noun; Estos/Estas son + plural noun.
speaking_outcome: Say what one thing is and what several things are.

cards.pedagogy_note: Das sind: one word das, plural verb sind, plural noun.
Rucksack, Rucksäcke: the a gets two dots.

cards.spanish_translation: What is it? These are books.
What is it? These are cars.
cards.pedagogy_note: Build: what is it? These are cars.
